name: SiliconFlow
description: Chinese inference platform whose China site keeps a set of models at zero price.
overview: SiliconFlow is a Chinese inference platform with an OpenAI-compatible API. Its China site keeps a set of small and distilled models at $0, while the international site offers only a $1 starter credit. Free models require a Chinese mobile number for verification.
free_access: Selected models priced at $0 on siliconflow.cn
notes: Free $0 models are on siliconflow.cn and need a Chinese mobile number; siliconflow.com has no free models.
